AGGREGATE_GUARD_predeclared.why_needed: The absolute 2.4e-3 bar is biased in OPPOSITE directions per member. Measured own-noise sd: replica_00 6.17e-4 (bar = 3.89 sd, LOOSER than a 2-sigma within-noise test, so it can PASS a member whose dL is outside its own noise); replica_49 7.276e-4 (3.30 sd); replica_45 1.485e-3 (bar = 1.62 sd, STRICTER, so it can FAIL a member whose dL is inside its own noise). Factor 2.4 across three members. Quiet members get a CONFIRM-ward bias, noisy members an away-from-CONFIRM bias.
